_comment: Iteration 2 of the mask-collapse-weight diagnostic. Iteration 1 (configs/shadespp_tau050_maskfix.json: 160 images, 2 epochs) made things worse -- mask coverage moved 3.1%->4.7% toward the 15% target but its max value collapsed from ~1.0 to ~0.12, suggesting it was chasing the coverage target by flagging everything mildly rather than learning real specular regions. This iteration restarts from the same original v_tau050 checkpoint (not iteration 1's) with more data and more epochs to give it a real chance to learn, rather than stacking on top of an already-undertrained result.
